code:
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]                 # not every branch
    paths: ["src/**", "deploy.sh"]   # skip runs when only docs/images change
  workflow_dispatch:                 # expensive path stays manual/on-demand
description: An `on` block that restricts automatic runs to one branch and a set of paths, and keeps the expensive path on manual dispatch.

steps.description: This is the `on` block, the triggers for a workflow. It scopes automatic runs so a docs-only edit does not start a full build.
`push` fires on a push, and `branches: [main]` narrows it to `main`. The comment notes this is not every branch.
`paths` limits the run to changes under `src/**` or to `deploy.sh`. The comment states the point: skip runs when only docs or images change.
`workflow_dispatch` lets a person start the run on demand. The comment calls this the expensive path that stays manual.

title: Scoping Automatic Triggers
